summary: Myseum.AI, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 17, 2026, disclosing a commercial partnership with FUJIFILM North America Corporation announced via press release on September 16, 2026. The arrangement embeds Fujifilm print-on-demand products into the Company's Picture Party private social platform, with a service launch expected later in September 2026. No financial terms, equity stake, pricing, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction structure were disclosed. This is an ordinary commercial contract event, not a special situation, though the new revenue stream may warrant monitoring for future financial impact.
